requirements.source: S17.11.9 p1/p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF491.
requirements.definition: IEEE_GET_STATUS is the simple subroutine whose description is get floating-point status.

requirements.title: IEEE_GET_STATUS argument and saved status value
requirements.source: S17.11.9 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF491.
requirements.definition: STATUS_VALUE shall be a scalar IEEE_STATUS_TYPE INTENT(OUT) argument assigned the current floating-point status.

pending.IEEE_GET_STATUS-STATUS_VALUE-scalar-ieee: Positive source control declares TYPE(IEEE_STATUS_TYPE) :: status_value and calls IEEE_GET_STATUS(status_value); source-control mutation uses TYPE(IEEE_MODES_TYPE) and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_GET_STATUS-assigns-current-status: For each listed flag F in IEEE_INVALID, IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT, run a separate branch probing IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(F). Supported branch quiets IEEE_ALL, sets F signaling with IEEE_SET_FLAG, calls IEEE_GET_STATUS(save), quiets F, calls IEEE_SET_STATUS(save), and asserts IEEE_GET_FLAG(F) returns signaling while a companion quiet setup returns quiet. Unsupported branch records skip.
